has entered into a private placement of up to 3.45M common shares at a price of C$2.90 per offered share for aggregate gross proceeds of ~C$10M.
The company has agreed to grant the agents an option to sell up to 689,655 additional offered shares for aggregate gross proceeds of up to ~C$2M.

Scottie has also amended the size of the previously announced non-brokered private placement announced on September 11, 2026, to C$17M. It is expected to be completed concurrently with the current offering. Both the offerings are expected to provide aggregate gross proceeds of up to C$27M, or up to C$29M if the agents' option is exercised in full.
